## File Calling and Filtering
```{r}
metadata <- readRDS("data/IFNy_data/IFNy_RNASeq/IFNy_metadata.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/IFNy_data/IFNy_RNASeq/Ensembl_Condition_filtered_log2cpm_counts_df.RDS")

cleaned_metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Condition %in% c("C_IFNy_C2R", "C_VEH_C2R", "H_IFNy_H4R", "H_VEH_H4R"))

cleaned_counts <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C_IFNy_C2R, C_VEH_C2R))
```

## GO/KEGG

### gProfiler2 GO:BP Attempt
```{r gProfiler2 BP Human analyses, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}

toptable_results <- readRDS("data/IFNy_data/IFNy_RNASeq/toptable_results.RDS")

bg_genes <- cleaned_counts %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

human_trt <- toptable_results$IFNyvVEH_H %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
  mutate(species = "Human")

chimp_trt <- toptable_results$IFNyvVEH_C %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
  mutate(species = "Chimp")

species_trt <- bind_rows(human_trt, chimp_trt)

human_degs <- human_trt %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(Ensembl)

chimp_degs <- chimp_trt %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(Ensembl)

gost_human <- gost(
  query = human_degs,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  significant = TRUE,
  custom_bg = bg_genes,
  correction_method = "fdr",
  sources = "GO:BP"
)

gost_chimp <- gost(
  query = chimp_degs,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  significant = TRUE,
  custom_bg = bg_genes,
  correction_method = "fdr",
  sources = "GO:BP"
)

human_GO <- gost_human$result

gost_human$result
gost_chimp$result
# length(gost_human$result$query)
# length(gost_chimp$result$query)

# gostplot(gost_human)

human_GO %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 20) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_name = factor(term_name,
                       levels = term_name)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(p_value),
             y = rev(term_name),
             size = intersection_size,
             color = p_value)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    y = NULL,
    size = "GeneCount"
  )
#length(unique(human_GO$term_id))
```

### enrichGO GO term functions

```{r enrichGO set-up code}
toptable_list <- readRDS("data/IFNy_data/IFNy_RNASeq/toptable_results.RDS")
comparison_name_list <- list("VEH: Human vs Chimp", "IFNy: Human vs Chimp", "Human: IFNy vs VEH", "Chimp: IFNy vs VEH", "Interaction")
enrichGO_setup <- function(toptable, comparison_name) {

  enrichGO_bg <- toptable %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
    dplyr::pull(Ensembl)

  enrichGO_sig <- toptable %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Ensembl)

  if (length(enrichGO_sig) == 0) {
    message("No significant genes for ", comparison_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  enrichGO_sig_entrez <- bitr(
    enrichGO_sig,
    fromType = "ENSEMBL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )

  enrichGO_bg_entrez <- bitr(
    enrichGO_bg,
    fromType = "ENSEMBL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )

  list(
      comparison = comparison_name,
      enrichGO_sig_entrez = enrichGO_sig_entrez,
      enrichGO_bg_entrez = enrichGO_bg_entrez
  )
}

enrichGO_results <- vector("list", length(toptable_list))

for (i in seq_along(toptable_list)) {
  enrichGO_results[[i]] <- enrichGO_setup(
    toptable_list[[i]],
    comparison_name_list[[i]]
  )
}

```

```{r Function for clusterProfiler Human analyses, fig.height=6, fig.width=7, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
generate_GO_plots <- function(enrichGO_data, ontology){

  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene = enrichGO_data$enrichGO_sig_entrez$ENTREZID,
    universe = enrichGO_data$enrichGO_bg_entrez$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = ontology,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    readable = TRUE
  )

  if(is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0){
    message("No enriched ", ontology,
            " terms for ", enrichGO_data$comparison)
    return(NULL)
  }

  p <- barplot(
    ego,
    showCategory = 20,
    font.size = 10,
    title = paste0(enrichGO_data$comparison, " (GO:", ontology, ")")
  )

  return(p)
}

for(i in seq_along(toptable_list)){

  enrichGO_data <- enrichGO_setup(
    toptable_list[[i]],
    comparison_name_list[[i]]
  )

  if(is.null(enrichGO_data))
    next

  for(ontology in ontology_list){

    p <- generate_GO_plots(enrichGO_data,
                           ontology)

    if(!is.null(p))
      print(p)
  }
}
```

### gProfiler2 GO/KEGG term functions

```{r GO analyses setup code, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
## Setup function
comparison_name_list <- list("VEH: Human vs Chimp", "IFNy: Human vs Chimp", "Human: IFNy vs VEH", "Chimp: IFNy vs VEH", "Interaction")

gprofiler2_setup <- function(toptable, comparison_name){

  gprofiler2_degs <- toptable %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Ensembl)
  
  bg_genes <- cleaned_counts %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Ensembl)

  if(length(gprofiler2_degs) == 0){

    message("No significant genes for ", comparison_name)

    return(NULL)

  }

  list(
    comparison = comparison_name,
    gprofiler2_degs = gprofiler2_degs,
    bg_genes = bg_genes
  )
}

## Creating my input list
gprofiler2_results <- lapply(
  seq_along(toptable_list),
  function(i)
    gprofiler2_setup(
      toptable_list[[i]],
      comparison_name_list[[i]]
    )
)

```

```{r Generating figures illustrating GO/KEGG terms, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
## Generating a list of databases to query
source_list <- c(
  "GO:BP",
  "GO:MF",
  "GO:CC",
  "KEGG"
)

## Creating the enrichment function
generate_enrichment_results <- function(gprofiler2_data,
                                        source){
  gost_res <- gost(
    query = gprofiler2_data$gprofiler2_degs,
    custom_bg = gprofiler2_data$bg_genes,
    organism = "hsapiens",
    sources = source,
    significant = TRUE,
    correction_method = "fdr"
  )

  if(is.null(gost_res$result) ||
     nrow(gost_res$result) == 0){
    message(
      "No enriched ",
      source,
      " terms for ",
      gprofiler2_data$comparison
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  gost_res$result %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison = gprofiler2_data$comparison,
      source = source
    )
}

## Running the enrichment function
gprofiler2_results_df <- tibble()

for(data in gprofiler2_results){
  if(is.null(data))
    next

  for(source in source_list){
    result <- generate_enrichment_results(
      data,
      source
    )
    if(!is.null(result))
      gprofiler2_results_df <-
        bind_rows(
          gprofiler2_results_df,
          result
        )
  }
}

## Now to plot GO and KEGG Terms separately
for(comp in unique(gprofiler2_results_df$comparison)){
  for(src in unique(gprofiler2_results_df$source)){
    
    plot_df <- gprofiler2_results_df %>%
      filter(
        comparison == comp,
        source == src
      ) %>%
      slice_min(
        order_by = p_value,
        n = 20,
        with_ties = FALSE
      )
    if(nrow(plot_df) == 0)
      next

### Code for dot plot    
    # plot_df <- plot_df %>%

    #   mutate(
    #     term_label = stringr::str_wrap(term_name, width = 40),
    #     term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(term_label))
    #     )  
    
    p <- ggplot(
        plot_df,
        aes(
          x = -log10(p_value),
          y = reorder(term_name, -log10(p_value)),
          size = intersection_size)) +
        geom_point(
          color = ifelse(src == "KEGG",
                         "#2E8B57",
                         "#5B4FA2")
        ) +
        
        labs(
          title = paste(comp, "-", src),
          x = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
          y = NULL,
          size = "GeneCount"
            ) +
        theme_classic() 
      print(p)
  }
}
```

### Heatmap comparing -log10(p-value) correlations of top GO_BP between species
```{r Species Comparison Heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

gost_human_hmp <- gost(
  query = human_degs,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  significant = FALSE,
  custom_bg = bg_genes,
  domain_scope = "custom",
  correction_method = "fdr",
  sources = "GO:BP"
)

gost_chimp_hmp <- gost(
  query = chimp_degs,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  significant = FALSE,
  custom_bg = bg_genes,
  domain_scope = "custom",
  correction_method = "fdr",
  sources = "GO:BP"
)

# nrow(gost_human_hmp$result)
# summary(gost_human_hmp$result$p_value)

human_go_hmp <- gost_human_hmp$result %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 300)

chimp_go_hmp <- gost_chimp_hmp$result %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 300)

top_term_set <- union(
    human_go_hmp$term_name,
    chimp_go_hmp$term_name
)

human_plot_hmp <- human_go_hmp %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        Human =
            ifelse(
                p_value < 0.05,
                -log10(p_value),   # significant
                -1                 # present but not significant
            )
    ) %>%
    select(term_name, Human)

chimp_plot_hmp <- chimp_go_hmp %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        Chimp =
            ifelse(
                p_value < 0.05,
                -log10(p_value),
                -1
            )
    ) %>%
    select(term_name, Chimp)

heatmap_df <- full_join(
    chimp_plot_hmp,
    human_plot_hmp,
    by = "term_name"
)

# heatmap_df_2 <- heatmap_df %>%
#     mutate(
#         Human = replace_na(Human, 0),
#         Chimp = replace_na(Chimp, 0)
#     )

hmp_matrix <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    term_name,
    Chimp,
    Human
  ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
  # slice_head(n=50) %>% 
  as.matrix()

#hmp_matrix

heatmap_colors <- colorRamp2(
    c(-1, 0, 1.30103, 25),
    c("blue", "blue", "white", "red")
)
Heatmap(
  hmp_matrix,
  name = "-log10(adj.P)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  # show_row_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = unit(12, "cm"),
  na_col = "darkgray",
  col = heatmap_colors
  )
#length(hmp_matrix)
```

```{r Top Term Comparison Heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = unit(12, "cm"),
  na_col = "darkgray",
  col = heatmap_colors
  )
```
